source_complexity_budget.scope: descriptor and affine-combination filtering before least squares; intermediate feature expansion still unconstrained

export_precision: observed native solve indices, raw-scale full coefficients/intercept; no rounded display parsing
native_check_scope: native selected descriptors on Train and declared-domain validation points; raw IEEE masks retained, common real validity separate
validation_probe_scope: declared input geometry; observed geometry reuses Train rows, not independent data

constraint_support.operators: native descriptor operators; affine add/mul and all exports post-filtered
constraint_support.units: explicit dimensional mode: native dimensional expansion/target-unit descriptor filter, dimensionless coefficients and target-unit intercept; nondimensional mode: coefficient units unknown; common structural check
constraint_support.max_nodes: source AST descriptor/combination budget before native affine coefficient fits; feature expansion intermediates not bounded
constraint_support.variables: disallowed columns excluded before native search; full-schema export/prediction checked
constraint_support.allowed_variables: native input-column subset with original IDs; no constant-only or mapped-input/template subset fallback
constraint_support.probes: finite-point hard constrained coefficient fit for each explored SIS subset; no global guarantee
constraint_support.response_bounds: hard coefficient constraints within subset search
constraint_support.response_checks: finite-step hard coefficient constraints within subset search; not analytic derivative proof

operator_policy: unavailable_search_operators is the requested/export-capability difference, not decoder reachability; generation enforcement and context-dependent routes are specified by constraint_support and native metadata
